messages:
Anya: quick check on the mini-flow I mocked — goal is clearer burst labeling and reducing accidental overrides when people set min > pool cap. dropping screenshots in the figma link.
Jess: nice. main copy nit: change `Burst` to `Temporary burst (duration)` and show inline choices: 5m / 30m / 1h. shortens cognitive load.
Mike: visual: move numeric cost estimate to the right, tone down sparkline contrast, and ensure the cost anim respects prefers-reduced-motion.
Ben: backend: 5m uses preemptible instances; 1h may fall back to reserved. will publish supported durations so UI can gray unsupported options per pool.
Sam: a11y: add aria-live region for guardrail and cost messages. keyboard: arrow=1, shift+arrow=5, pageup/pagedown=10. ensure pool selector is first in tab order.
Anya: UX decision: auto-snap to pool max with an Undo toast (3s default) vs blocking modal. leaning auto-snap + undo — less disruptive.
Jess: microcopy for undo toast: "Adjusted to pool max (8 GPUs) to protect SLOs. Undo" + tiny 'Why?' link. localize length-aware timeout.
Mike: when user explicitly overrides after undo window, show inline persistent warning with actions: `Save anyway` (primary) and `Adjust to recommendation`. record telemetry.
Ben: will add auto_correct and override telemetry fields and rate-limit quota requests.
design-bot: mock uploaded: https://www.figma.com/file/unique123/mini-burst-clarity - frames: "MiniFlow-v3", "Undo-toast".
Anya: action items: Jess finalize copy, Sam add aria snippets to checklist, Mike tweak contrast and motion, Ben publish durations. I'll update figma and loop back for a quick sweep tomorrow. :thumbsup:
